title: Regulated Disposal Addition for Old Units, Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
On a customer-elected cash settlement under a Homeowner Service Contract, and only on such a settlement, the cash carries the disposal addition described here for the old unit the customer's own installer must take away, and no supplemental allowance is booked; every other cash settlement and every out-of-network reimbursement remains under the general allowance rule.

The disposal addition pays for the regulated disposal the customer now arranges for the old unit:

| Old unit | Disposal addition | Why |
|---|---|---|
| refrigerator or cooling system | 75.00 | its refrigerant must be recovered by a certified technician |
| water heater or heating system | 50.00 | — |
| any other item | nothing | — |

The addition is added to the cash starting figure before that figure is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits.

*Hypothetical:* a homeowner on Bridgewell HomeCare Silver taking cash for a cooling system receives a 75.00 disposal addition in the cash; one taking cash for a clothes dryer receives none.
